transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: Enough debate. We can't afford hesitation. The finance pitch is mine to lead, and responsibility sits with me. Anyone with objections, see me after. We're moving forward now. Understood?

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Okay, Park. Just to confirm, will we have a chance to review the proposal against the latest compliance checklist before it’s final? I want to make sure we don’t miss anything.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Park, could we get a quick look at the draft before it's sent off? Just want to make sure we’re not overlooking anything, especially with compliance.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Alright, Park. If you can share the draft with me after the meeting, I’ll check the financials for any gaps. Wouldn’t want anything to slip through, especially now.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Park, just to be sure, will the full team get a quick look at the draft before it’s final? I want to check the HR sections for anything we might overlook.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: If we're skipping the group review, just want to be sure—who's double-checking compliance and the financials before it goes out? Last time, we missed a detail that almost cost us.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Park, just flagging—if the draft comes out today, I’ll double-check the technical sections for compliance gaps. We really can’t afford a miss right now. Just send it my way when you have it.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Park, could I get a quick look at the draft too? Just want to make sure the user experience side’s covered—shouldn’t take long. Would hate for us to miss something small right now.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Park, just so I’m clear—you’ll be leading on the finance pitch and taking responsibility for the draft. I’m hearing a lot of people worried about missing something if we don’t do at least a quick review as a team. Is there room for a short walkthrough before it goes out? Even ten minutes could help catch what we might overlook.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Could we just get five minutes as a group to glance at the draft before it goes? Might help us spot anything off—last time we missed a detail.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Seems like most of us are hoping to see the draft, even if just for a few minutes. I think a quick group check could help us avoid trouble later.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Yeah, if we get a few minutes to review, that covers my concerns. Just let me know when it's ready, Park.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Feels like the team’s leaning toward a quick review. Even just a short window to catch mistakes would help. Park, could we have that?

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Park, it sounds like everyone would feel better with even a short team look at the draft. Is there a way to make that work without slowing you down?

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Just to add, a fast group look means we catch UX issues too—not just numbers or compliance. Even five minutes could save us trouble.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: If it helps, I’ll review the technical compliance parts as soon as the draft’s out. Five minutes for everyone’s eyes on it should do the trick. Just let us know when it’s ready, Park.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: I agree with the group. If we can just get five minutes to look at the draft together, that's all I think we need. It’ll help us catch anything obvious.

transcript.name: Park Jae-Won
transcript.text: Fine. Five minutes, no more. I’ll circulate the draft once it’s ready—everyone glances at their section, then it’s closed. Next time, we stick to protocol. Understood?

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Okay, thanks, Park. I’ll check my section as soon as the draft’s out.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Alright, when the draft’s out, I’ll review the strategy section right away. Let’s all try to flag anything major fast so Park isn’t held up.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Alright, five minutes it is. I’ll keep my eyes out for anything off in my section—just flag if you spot something, too.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Alright, I’ll check the HR parts as soon as it comes through. If anyone spots something off in that section, let me know right away.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Alright, I’ll look over the compliance checklist as soon as the draft’s out. Just flag me if anything’s unclear.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: I’ll keep an eye out for the draft and check my section as soon as it comes through. Just flag me if you spot anything odd in the financials.
